CDMX nominal PIB 2023 = 4,717,467 millones de pesos corrientes (precios de mercado). CDMX = 14.8% of national PIB in 2023.

PIB a precios de mercado, precios constantes 2018 (Cuadro 1, miles de millones): CDMX=3,886 mmp, national=25,365 mmp. National nominal 2024=33,506,847 millones corrientes. CDMX contributed 15.0% of national PIB in 2024 (largest of all states).
INEGI states CDMX contributed 15.0% of national PIB in 2024 (14.8% in 2023). Highest single-entity share nationally.
Actividades primarias = 0.0% of CDMX total product (2023, valores corrientes).
Actividades secundarias = 9.9% of CDMX total product (2023). Includes manufacturing + construction + utilities. Remaining 6.6% is ISPN (net taxes on products).

Manufacturing is a SUBSET of the 9.9% secondary sector (which also includes construction and utilities). INEGI boletin does not state the manufacturing-only VAB share directly; it must be pulled from the PIBE tabulados SCIAN sector 31-33 at https://www.inegi.org.mx/programas/pibent/2018/. Upper bound < 9.9%; manufacturing declined 1.2% in 2023. Precise value NOT found in press releases.

Actividades terciarias (services) = 83.5% of CDMX total product (2023, valores corrientes). CDMX economy is overwhelmingly services. (In 2021 the terciario share was 89.4% of the non-tax product; 2023 press release reports shares against total incl. 6.6% ISPN.)
